2. From the repository root, run `python3 scripts/codex/studio.py context changelog`.
3. Read the [shared workflow](../../../.claude/skills/changelog/SKILL.md) and follow
   its body using that context and the runtime translations. Read its supporting
   references only when the current phase needs them.
